title: Filling Before Advancing: Capability-Gap-Driven Post-Training for Scenario-Specialized Remote Sensing MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2607.22205v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS-MLLMs) have advanced aerial-image understanding, but scenario specialization remains constrained by scarce high-quality supervision and incomplete capability coverage. We propose filling before advancing (FBA), a capability-gap-driven post-training route that develops prerequisite capabilities before scenario-specific adaptation. For coastal harbor understanding, we construct CPRS (Coastal-Port Remote Sensing), a three-layer dataset covering RGB, SAR, PAN, and NIR imagery. FBA organizes supervision into RS semantic anchoring, multi-source bridging, and evidence-grounded scenario tuning. We also introduce HarborEval, an eight-track benchmark assessing perception, spatial understanding, robustness, and generation. translated_title: 先补齐再前进：面向场景专用遥感多模态大语言模型的能力差距驱动后训练
translated_abstract: 遥感多模态大语言模型（RS-MLLMs）在航空影像理解方面已取得进展，但场景专业化仍受限于高质量监督数据的稀缺和能力覆盖的不完整。我们提出“先补齐再前进”（Filling Before Advancing, FBA），这是一种能力差距驱动的后训练路线，在进行场景特定适配之前先培养前置能力。针对沿海港口理解任务，我们构建了CPRS（Coastal-Port Remote Sensing，沿海港口遥感）数据集，这是一个覆盖RGB、SAR、PAN和NIR影像的三层数据集。FBA将监督数据组织为遥感语义锚定、多源桥接和证据支撑的场景微调三个阶段。我们还引入了HarborEval，一个从感知、空间理解、鲁棒性和生成能力等八个维度进行评估的基准。在相同的最终任务监督数据池下，与直接训练方法相比，FBA在LLaVA-v1.5上将HarborEval得分从57.95提升至70.29，在Qwen3-VL上从81.09提升至83.37。
tldr: 提出能力差距驱动的后训练方法FBA，通过先培养前置能力再进行场景微调，并构建沿海港口遥感数据集CPRS与HarborEval基准，显著提升了遥感多模态大语言模型在港口理解任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: FBA is a capability-gap-driven post-training approach that develops prerequisite capabilities before scenario-specific adaptation, and combined with the CPRS dataset and HarborEval benchmark, it significantly improves remote sensing MLLMs' performance on coastal harbor understanding.
